text:
Nina C: Morning — two days post-launch check. We have a pile of streaming follow-ups. Need a fast split: HOTFIX (customer-blocking or Sev1/2 with >2% sessions) vs NEXT-SPRINT. Propose we auto-escalate any dedicated-tenant reports.

Harold J: Agreed. Quick datapoint: reconnect-truncation shows ~1.8% overall but 3 dedicated tenants show >6% each.

Mina S: Support asks for a "retry" affordance in the SDKs. That feels like NEXT-SPRINT unless it's preventing onboarding.

Troy P: I prefer a small hotfix bundle with only tenant-scoped fixes and a telemetry capture change. Keep non-blocking UX in Sprint 2.

ops-bot: Telemetry query: streams.reconnect.failures last_7d -> total 152 failures (1.8%). Top tenants: tenant-alpha=48 (6.3%), tenant-beta=42 (5.8%), tenant-gamma=36 (6.0%).

Nina C: OK that confirms enterprise impact. I'll mark RI-3100, RI-3103, RI-3111 as HOTFIX because they affect dedicated tenants.

Harold J: For the hotfix, minimal plan: patch guard in kv-cache, add reconnect idempotency check, no protocol change. Canary us-central 30m then expand.

Mina S: I'll scope retry UX as two stories: (1) SDK retry function + guidance, (2) UI-level retry sample. Both NEXT-SPRINT.

Troy P: Acceptance checklist for hotfix: reproduce on replay harness, perf smoke (95th <= baseline*1.1), tenant verification, and roll-forward plan.

Nina C: Assignments: Harold -> patch + PR, Troy -> canary run, Mina -> customer comms draft for affected tenants, I'll open Sprint card for the NEXT-SPRINT items.

Harold J: PR created for kv-cache guard: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-3100. Marking for hotfix bundle.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: hotfix-3100-3103 -> us-central at 2026-03-23T01:00:00Z (30m). Notifying eng-oncall.

Troy P: Starting preflight: replay traces loading, smoke harness ready. Will post canary link when running.

Mina S: Customer note draft: "We are deploying a targeted fix for intermittent truncated streams affecting dedicated tenants. Expect brief canary followed by broader rollout if green. We'll notify you after verification." Ping me for tone.

Nina C: Good. If canary fails, we'll revert and escalate to a 4-hour incident window. If green, we ship and then track reconnect rates for the three tenants for 72h.

Harold J: One more ask: add a small telemetry flag to capture reconnect session ids for failed attempts (retention 7 days) so support can match tickets to traces. Low-risk, helps troubleshooting.

Nina C: Add that to the hotfix telemetry subtask. Okay team, executing. We'll reconvene only if rollback or new regression appears. :rocket:
